actual_output: Proposed standard: accuracy=0.183709, Macro F1=0.043183, active classes=2.33, zero-recall=10.67. Class-weighted: accuracy=0.150202, Macro F1=0.066090, active classes=6.33, zero-recall=7.67. Train max/min canonical class counts=1623/184 (ratio 8.82).

question: Q6
claim_checked: The split audit finds repeated transaction IDs but zero exact available-record overlaps; merchant-disjoint evaluation is not established.
check_performed: Check ID overlap, exact available-field overlap and normalised note-value overlap; inspect available columns.
actual_output: Overlapping transaction-ID values: train–validation=106; train–test=166; validation–test=40. Exact available-record overlaps=[0, 0, 0]; shared normalised note values=[24, 24, 24]. Transaction IDs are not globally unique, so repeated ID values alone do not establish duplicated transactions. No reliable merchant identifier or separate merchant-description field is available.
limitation_or_required_wording: The available-field check does not establish merchant-disjoint splitting, absence of semantic/near-duplicate overlap, or exclusion of all data leakage. Do not claim zero transaction-ID overlap or complete partition independence.
